title_en: Strat Training for Battle Now, Because the Second Wave of Hasbro's Street Fighter Movie Figures Has Been Revealed
summary_en: IGN can exclusively reveal the second wave of Hasbro's incredibly detailed Street Fighter movie figures, including Cody Rhodes' Guile and Jason Momoa's Blanka.
body_en:
Hasbro's reveal of their Street Fighter movie action figures was one of the coolest announcements to come out of SDCC this past summer. The only problem is that the initial lineup barely scratches the surface of the film's ensemble cast . Luckily, Hasbro is following up that series with a second wave of figures that includes Cody Rhodes' Guile and Jason Momoa's Blanka.
Ahead of their full debut at NYCC 2026, IGN can exclusively reveal the next series of Street Fighter movie figures. Get a closer look in the slideshow gallery below:
The second wave of Street Fighter figures includes Rhodes' Guile, Momoa's Blanka, David Dastmalchian's M. Bison, and Andrew Koji's Dark Ryu.
As with the previous wave, these Street Fighter figures are designed at 6-inch scale and feature extensive articulation. Each figure will come with accessories like swappable open and closed fists and energy pieces.
Also like the first series, these figures will be sold exclusively at Walmart. Preorders for all four figures will open on Thursday, October 8 at 7am PT, with a release date of December 1. You can find preorder links for all four below, along with links for the Series 1 figures (which are available now):
Hasbro also just released a series of Street Fighter Mystery Warriors blind box figures, which are also exclusive to Walmart and available for purchase now. You can see images in the slideshow gallery above.
Not to be outdone, Funko has also gotten in the Street Fighter game with a series of Funko Pop! figures based on the film . You can also check out Hasbro's hotly anticipated The Legend of Zelda figures .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
